name: upstream-sync-2
title: Sync upstream main (9 commits, incl. IP request limiting) and port to the HarmonyOS app
description: Merge 9 new upstream commits into the fork: the new per-IP incoming request limiting, transfer failure on unreadable files, save-location path resolution, zero-padding fix, upstream's Kyrgyz locale fix (identical to ours), plus tests/docs. Resolve the directories.dart conflict by keeping the fork's if/else (OHOS rule: no exhaustive defaultTargetPlatform switch) while adopting upstream's symlink resolution. Verify the full suite and the HarmonyOS constraints, land via PR, then build a fresh HAP for manual QA.
